name: IO Orion
source:
Faction: US Forces
Skill: Slimy Skin (Slimy Skin), Slimy Armor (Slimy Armor)
Artist: [url=/s3445]Asagiri[/url]
Cards: [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/8411cf8cf9d3f38f3dce7c556bed323e.png]US 3 Stars[/url], [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/76c655fa6a4d215bf9a9ca5afe506a11.png]US 4 Stars[/url]
History:
Io grew up in a damaged household, her father would abuse her multiple times and she developed a strange behavior in which she was intentionally put herself in more risky situations, such as hiding in wardrobe. Io naturally enjoyed the thrill of danger but when a burglar broke into their house and murdered her father, Io witnessing it all. Though, traumatized, Io felt both fearful and weirdly liberated.
As she got older, she joined as an undercover agent for the UFS Bureau of Investigation. She became one of the best agents in the world, not only at infiltration missions, but also at combat and sabotage. In particular, she is unrivaled in her ability to gather information during long-term undercover missions, and is able to update information in real time.
Io has been given the code-name "Satellite" for her ability to perform multiple missions simultaneously, her main mission is to infiltrate hostile nations, but it is also able to infiltrate demon tribes and Taimanin forces without difficulty. Io still hides that she feels thrilled by danger even now.
[From [url=https://breezewiki.com/taimanin/wiki/Io_Orion]breezewiki.com[/url]]
